snp5.3:1.1:
Who
here in the world
is contented?
snp5.3:1.6:
Whom
do you call a great person?
snp5.3:1.7:
Who here
has gone past
the seamstress?—
craving.
snp5.3:2.1:
The Buddha:
He who
in the midst of sensualities,
follows the holy life,
snp5.3:2.4:
the monk who is
—through fathoming things—
unbound:
snp5.3:3.1:
He,
the thinker
knowing both sides,
snp5.3:3.3:
He
I call a great person.
snp5.3:3.4:
He
here has gone past
the seamstress: craving.
